titleEn: Maximum Length of Subarray With Positive Product
title: 乘积为正数的最长子数组长度
summary: 返回乘积为正数的最长连续子数组长度。
insight: 扫描维护以当前位置结尾、乘积为正与负的最长长度。正数延长两者；负数交换正负角色；零清空状态。
pitfalls: 负数会把正负状态互换
零不能包含在非零乘积子数组中

solutions.title: 正负结尾长度动态规划
solutions.idea: 压缩记录当前结尾两种乘积符号的最优长度。

code.java: class Solution { public int getMaxLen(int[] nums){int positive=0,negative=0,answer=0;for(int value:nums){if(value>0){positive++;if(negative>0)negative++;}else if(value<0){int newPositive=negative>0?negative+1:0,newNegative=positive+1;positive=newPositive;negative=newNegative;}else positive=negative=0;answer=Math.max(answer,positive);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun getMaxLen(nums:IntArray):Int{var positive=0;var negative=0;var answer=0;for(value in nums){if(value>0){positive++;if(negative>0)negative++}else if(value<0){val newPositive=if(negative>0)negative+1 else 0;val newNegative=positive+1;positive=newPositive;negative=newNegative}else{positive=0;negative=0};answer=maxOf(answer,positive)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int getMaxLen(vector<int>& nums){int positive=0,negative=0,answer=0;for(int value:nums){if(value>0){++positive;if(negative)++negative;}else if(value<0){int newPositive=negative?negative+1:0,newNegative=positive+1;positive=newPositive;negative=newNegative;}else positive=negative=0;answer=max(answer,positive);}return answer;} };
